The program focuses on discerning the most promising technological innovations to prepare students for the rapid evolution of information and communication technologies. ### Presentation of the Formation The Master Mention Informatique proposes an education that attaches importance to identifying, among technological innovations, those that are most promising. This allows students to adapt to the rapid evolution of technologies and prepares them for careers in various fields. ### Composante The program is offered by the Facultť Sciences et Ingťnierie. ### Parcours The Master Mention Informatique offers 8 different parcours: * Intelligence Artificielle: Fondements et Applications (IAFA) * Interaction Homme Machine (IHM) * Sciences du Logiciel (SDL) * SystŤmes Embarquťs et Connectťs: Infrastructures et Logiciels (SECIL) * Interactions de l'Informatique et des Mathťmatiques pour l'Intelligence Artificielle (IMA) * Recherche Opťrationnelle et Optimisation (RO) * Sciences et Ingťnierie des Donnťes (SID) * Computer Science for Aerospace (CSA) ### Details of Each Parcours #### Master Parcours Computer Science for Aerospace (CSA) * Duration: 2 years * Level of Exit: Bac + 5 (Niveau 7) * This parcours will not be open for enrollment in the 2026/2027 academic year. #### Master Parcours Intelligence Artificielle: Fondements et Applications (IAFA) * Duration: 2 years * Level of Exit: Bac + 5 (Niveau 7) * The IAFA parcours aims for a high level of mastery of AI foundations and develops expertise in students based on application domain problems and their societal and industrial impacts. #### Master Parcours Interaction Homme Machine (IHM) * Duration: 2 years * Level of Exit: Bac + 5 (Niveau 7) * The IHM Master forms professionals specializing in the design and development of interactive applications, mastering techniques specific to computer science, design, and human factors. #### Master Parcours Interactions de l'Informatique et des Mathťmatiques pour l'Intelligence Artificielle (IMA) * Duration: 2 years * Level of Exit: Bac + 5 (Niveau 7) * The IMA parcours aims to form experts in the field of AI by combining fundamental scientific skills in both mathematics and computer science. This parcours will not be open for enrollment in the 2026/2027 academic year. #### Master Parcours Recherche Opťrationnelle Optimisation (RO) * Duration: 2 years * Level of Exit: Bac + 5 (Niveau 7) * At the interface of Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, and Engineering, RO models complex systems of industry and large organizations to design decision-making tools. results.snippet:
Paul Sabatier University, also known as Toulouse 3, was a public university located in Toulouse, France. It was one of the several successor universities of the University of Toulouse, established in 1229, making it one of the earliest universities to emerge in Europe. On January 1, 2023, the existing Toulouse University System, which included Toulouse III, was renamed the Université de Toulouse. Then, on January 1, 2025, Toulouse III – Paul Sabatier University adopted the name Université de Toulouse (University of Toulouse), absorbing and incorporating the former Toulouse University System, with the Purpan Engineering School as a graduate school. [...] Toulouse III was named after Paul Sabatier "Paul Sabatier (chemist)"), winner of the 1912 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. In 1969, it was established on the foundations of the old Toulouse university that was itself founded in 1229.

Université Toulouse-III was a leading educational institution in France and the Midi-Pyrénées region. It offered a wide range of programs in science, technology, health and athletics.
